$schema_note: The intermediate artifact fix #2 introduces between planning and execution. Kept cloud-provider-neutral in shape (see research/history/GAME_PLAN.md's comparison table) so it stays retargetable from Floci to real AWS/GCP after PMF without a redesign. Written by the planner agent, read by the executor agent -- the two never share an underlying conversation.

example.app_context: a short, human-readable label for this app/project, chosen by the planner, stable across follow-up requests
example.founder_request: the verbatim request text this plan was built from, kept for traceability

matched_capabilities.resource_name: a deterministic name the planner chose for the underlying resource, e.g. <app_context>-photos

fallback.closest_capability_id: the nearest catalog entry, or null if nothing is close
fallback.question_for_founder: the exact plain-language question or statement to show the founder -- the executor relays this verbatim and provisions nothing

field_notes.matched_capabilities: Ordered so every entry's depends_on capability_ids appear earlier in the list -- the executor provisions in list order and does not re-resolve dependencies itself.
field_notes.reused_existing: true only if the planner found a real, live, compatible existing resource on Floci for this exact app_context and capability -- the planner must have actually checked, not assumed.
field_notes.resource_name: Always present, even when reused_existing is true, so the executor never has to guess a name.
field_notes.fallback: Present (non-null) only when matched_capabilities is empty. The two are mutually exclusive.
